newsitem.title: USA: Overseas Shipholding confirms Carnival bid.
newsitem.headline: Overseas Shipholding confirms Carnival bid.

text.p: Overseas Shipholding Group on Thursday confirmed that it received an acquisition offer from Carnival Corp for its Celebrity Cruise Lines.
"We've told them we would contact them if we had any interest in pursuing it," said spokesman Robert Cowen.
Overseas Shipbuilding jointly owns Celebrity with privately held Chandris Group. Celebrity also is privately held.
On June 17, Celebrity struck a deal to be acquired by Royal Caribbean Crusies Ltd for $500 million, plus the assumption of $800 million in debt.
Carnival late Wednesday offered to buy Celebrity for $525 million in cash or cash and stock.
Royal Caribbean could not be reached for comment on the rival bid.
